products.name: Google EmbeddingGemma 2
products.tagline: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
products.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.

products.name: ngram 2.0
products.tagline: Create explainers, screencasts, and AI avatar videos
products.description: Turn ideas, documents, and recordings into narrated videos. ngram analyzes uploaded videos and screen recordings to identify key moments and build clear product walkthroughs. Create animated explainers or add an AI avatar presenter, then refine your video in chat.

products.name: Base Code
products.tagline: Let your whole team build on your product
products.description: Base Code lets teams work directly on existing codebases from the browser. Connect GitHub, describe changes in plain language, preview them live, and send completed work through standard pull requests.

products.name: guilds.run
products.tagline: Create multi-agent workflows that you can trust
products.description: Open-source AI agent teams you can actually inspect. Debug every prompt, tool call, memory change, and agent interaction. Control permissions, edit context, and choose the model for each agent. Self-host for free. Stop guessing what your agents are doing.

products.name: Manifold MCP
products.tagline: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent
products.description: Manifold gives your agent live data from every marketing channel, in one hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code. Find keywords one push from page one. See if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend you. Watch the TikToks winning your niche. Read your competitors’ live ads. Catch Reddit threads asking for what you make. Get verified emails for buyers looking right now. Ask in plain words and your agent does the work. No pile of tabs. Free to start.

products.name: Ancher 2.0
products.tagline: Turn everything you read and save into work you can ship
products.description: Ancher is an AI knowledge workspace that turns everything you read, watch, and save into work you can actually use. Capture articles, videos, PDFs, posts, and ideas without organizing folders. Ancher connects related knowledge, lets you search and ask questions across your sources, and helps turn what you've learned into research briefs, reports, presentations, and content in your own voice. Your saved knowledge becomes more useful every time you add to it.

products.name: Hexis Cloud
products.tagline: One company brain for all your AI agents
products.description: Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that's important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it's context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!

products.name: Kudos 3.0
products.tagline: The AI that finds money you're missing and gets it back
products.description: Most money apps show you charts. Kudos does the work. Your home shows Your wins, one number for everything Kudos has earned or saved you, and your next best money move. Most people don't know their cards come with personalized offers they have to turn on by hand. Kudos activates them for you: about $800/yr in offers in early testing. Our AI also calls providers to lower your bills ($216/yr per negotiation) and cancels subscriptions you forgot ($247/yr each). You keep 100% of the savings.

products.name: Scrape Anything by Context.dev
products.tagline: Turn any website into clean data with one API call.
products.description: Scrape Anything by Context lets you pull clean, usable data from the web without building or maintaining scraping infrastructure. Give Context a URL and it handles rendering, blocks, proxies, retries, and extraction—returning Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured data through one API.

products.name: Bearconnect 2.0
products.tagline: AI-Powered LinkedIn Platform for Content and Outreach
products.description: Bearconnect started as a LinkedIn outreach tool. With V2, it’s now a platform for both inbound and outbound on LinkedIn. Create and schedule content, find prospects from LinkedIn activity, and turn intent into conversations with AI-powered messaging. V2 also adds team workspaces, role-based access, Brand Voice, CRM integrations, and webhooks.

products.name: ExcaliClaw
products.tagline: Hand-drawn diagrams your AI agent can draw with you
products.description: ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn diagrams. Organize them in collections, search instantly, share by link or by name, and draw together in real time. Its MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code create and edit diagrams for you. Generous free plan: 200 drawings and unlimited AI (MCP) use, no credit card. Paid plans from €9/month. Version history, trash and backup export included. English, Español, Français.

products.name: Dropstone CLI
products.tagline: The self-learning coding agent for your terminal
products.description: Dropstone CLI is a coding agent that learns from you. It reads your repo, edits across files, runs commands and tests, and checks its work before it says it's done. Correct it once and it keeps the lesson across sessions. Pick Fast, Pro, or Heavy models, plan before it builds, and set which commands run, ask first, or are blocked. Add skills, custom agents, parallel subagents, and MCP tools. Comment on a GitHub issue and it opens a pull request. On every plan, including Free.

products.name: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner
products.tagline: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents
products.description: Invited is an AI reminder scanner that turns bills, invitations, cheques, screenshots and PDFs into smart reminders. It extracts dates, times, places and amounts, supports 80+ languages and 9 calendars, and finds multiple reminders in one document.

products.name: Understory Notes
products.description: Understory is a Mac notes app for people who take notes in order to write something. Collect notes as you read, arrange them into an outline, and draft each section with your research beside it. Then publish as a PDF, Rich Text, Markdown or a website.

products.name: SquadRoom
products.description: SquadRoom gives you a team of AI employees. A lead agent learns your company and plans the work. Specialists for research, writing, partnerships and operations do it. You drop a task on the board and walk away. When you come back, the work is finished and a report shows every step and every source. Agents only stop to ask you when a decision really needs you, and nothing goes out without your OK. Bring your own AI key. Try the live demo, no signup.
